title: Photon-echo synchronization and quantum state transfer in short quantum links
summary: The short quantum link regime, where the photon travel time $τ$ is comparable to the emitter lifetime $1/γ$, is experimentally relevant but theoretically underexplored: existing few-mode descriptions lose validity as retardation and multimode effects become significant.
